query:
Diagnose this workflow problem and explain the root cause and the correct fix direction:

ComfyUI-GGUF 2.0.0 on Windows: GGUFModelPatcher.unpatch_model with unpatch_weights=True touches GGUF mmap'd raw tensor memory during cache cleanup → access-violation crash (regression from 2.0.0 refactor; 1.1.6 had the fix).

desired.outcome: OP gives definitive cause + one-line fix: pass unpatch_weights=False to super().unpatch_model(device_to, unpatch_weights=False) so the base patcher never touches mmap weight memory; model still unloads normally, no crash (OP-verified).
desired.quality: Diagnosis names the correct root cause (matching the recorded root cause) and proposes the fix direction; depth of reasoning matters more than exact wording.
desired.answer_guidance: raffetazarius suggests using the v1.1 LTX-2.3 upscaler since v1.0 had a known issue; unconfirmed by OP.
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Debug a 2.0.0-regression access violation where GGUFModelPatcher.unpatch_model touches mmap'd weight memory during cache cleanup, and reason about why unpatch_weights=False prevents it.
